description: Structured eval definitions for the Lightsail Container Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Lightsail Container topologies (public image with managed TLS, ECR private with IAM auth, cost-vs-HA scale/power trade-off, custom domain via CNAME, missing ECR credentials prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Lightsail container with public Docker Hub image and managed TLS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — public image (nginx), small power, 2 nodes, managed TLS, health check, environment variables
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lightsail Container Service named web-frontend in us-east-1. Power: small. Scale: 2 nodes. Container image: nginx:latest from Docker Hub. Container port 80 mapped to HTTP. Public endpoint with health check on / every 5 seconds, threshold 2. Environment variables: ENV=production, LOG_LEVEL=info. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LIGHTSAIL_CONTAINER: web-frontend
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Container service: web-frontend — power small, 2 nodes
  [✓] Container image: nginx:latest — public (Docker Hub)
  [✓] ECR auth: Not needed (public image)
  [✓] Container port: 80 → HTTP
  [✓] Public endpoint: HTTPS, managed TLS
  [✓] Health check: / — interval 5s, threshold 2
  [✓] Environment variables: 2 variables
  [✓] Managed TLS: auto-provisioned
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lightsail get-container-services --service-name web-frontend

eval_cases.name: Lightsail container with ECR private image and IAM auth
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — ECR private image, medium power, 3 nodes, ECR access key, CloudWatch Logs
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lightsail Container Service named api-service in us-east-1. Power: medium. Scale: 3 nodes. Container image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/api-service:v2.1 from ECR private registry. ECR access key: AKIAABCDE12345 with secret key provided. Container port 8080 mapped to HTTP. Public endpoint with health check on /health every 5 seconds. Enable CloudWatch Logs. Tags: Environment=production, Team=backend.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LIGHTSAIL_CONTAINER: api-service
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Container service: api-service — power medium, 3 nodes
  [✓] Container image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/api-service:v2.1 — ECR private
  [✓] ECR auth: access key configured
  [✓] Container port: 8080 → HTTP
  [✓] Public endpoint: HTTPS, managed TLS
  [✓] CloudWatch Logs: enabled

eval_cases.name: Lightsail container with cost-vs-HA scale/power trade-off
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — medium power with 2 nodes for redundancy instead of large x 1, ECR image
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lightsail Container Service named worker-service in us-east-1. I want high availability at moderate cost. Power: medium. Scale: 2 nodes (for redundancy). Container image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/worker:v1.0 from ECR. ECR credentials configured. Container port 3000 mapped to HTTP. Health check on /health. Environment variables: WORKER_CONCURRENCY=10. Tags: Environment=production, Strategy=cost-ha-balance.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LIGHTSAIL_CONTAINER: worker-service
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Container service: worker-service — power medium, 2 nodes
  [✓] Scale: 2 nodes — production redundancy
  [✓] Container port: 3000 → HTTP

eval_cases.name: Lightsail container with custom domain via CNAME
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — large power, 3 nodes, ECR image, custom domain app.example.com via CNAME, managed TLS extended
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lightsail Container Service named app-prod in us-east-1. Power: large. Scale: 3 nodes. Container image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/app:v3.0 from ECR (credentials configured). Container port 443 mapped to HTTP. Public endpoint with health check on /healthz. Custom domain: app.example.com via CNAME to the Lightsail public endpoint. Enable CloudWatch Logs. Tags: Environment=production, Domain=custom.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LIGHTSAIL_CONTAINER: app-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Container service: app-prod — power large, 3 nodes
  [✓] Custom domain: app.example.com (CNAME configured)
  [✓] Managed TLS: auto-provisioned, extended to custom domain

eval_cases.name: Lightsail container with ECR image but no credentials (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — ECR private image requested but no registry credentials provided
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lightsail Container Service named data-processor in us-east-1. Power: small. Scale: 1 node. Container image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/processor:v1.0 from ECR private registry. No ECR credentials have been provided. Container port 8080. Tags: Environment=dev.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LIGHTSAIL_CONTAINER: data-processor
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] ECR auth: credentials NOT provided — IAM access key with ECR read permissions required for private image pull
